kicker: Customer chupchaap band kar deta hai
title: Tiffin customer *bina bataye* chala jaata hai. Kyun?
message:
Hi [naam] 🍱 is hafte ka menu:
Mon [dish] · Tue [dish] · Wed [dish]...
Koi din *skip* karna ho to us din ka naam reply karo, paisa adjust ho jayega.
*Feedback*: pichle hafte kya pasand nahi aaya?
why: *skip ka option* do to customer pause karta hai, band nahi. Aur feedback se pata chalta hai woh kyun ja raha tha.
caption:
Tiffin service mein customer shikayat nahi karta. Bas ek din bolta hai "kal se mat bhejna". 🍱

Weekly message:
1️⃣ Agle hafte ka menu
2️⃣ Skip ka option (paisa adjust)
3️⃣ Ek sawaal: kya pasand nahi aaya?

Skip ka option = pause, cancel nahi. Save karo 🔖
